CVE-2019-17582.title: A use-after-free in the _zip_dirent_read function of zip_dirent.c ...
CVE-2019-17582.description: A use-after-free in the _zip_dirent_read function of zip_dirent.c in libzip 1.2.0 allows attackers to have an unspecified impact by attempting to unzip a malformed ZIP archive. NOTE: the discoverer states "This use-after-free is triggered prior to the double free reported in CVE-2017-12858."
